why: The lesson's own common mistake: `git add .` staged waiting.py too. `git status` lists waiting.py under 'Changes to be committed', not 'Untracked files', so the step (stage hello.md and learning.py, leave waiting.py untracked) is not what happened; both file names are still on screen.
